damage_states.D1: Battered: dented armor, scuffed surfaces; full gait
damage_states.D2: Component damage: buckled FL shin, breached hull, reduced stride/lift; half aiming sector
damage_states.D3: Disabled wreck: lowered body, spread legs, stripped armor, sagged laser; no movement or firing

lod_selection.lod1: Animated mobile gameplay unit; retain while moving
lod_selection.lod2: Static parked map/loading representation; one material/draw; swap to LOD1 before walking

animation.gait: Alternating tripod; FL/MR/RL and FR/ML/RR; duty factor 0.6
animation.integration: Use baked gait OR procedural applyMech, never both on leg pivots. Advance root +Z at stride / (0.6 * 4) metres/sec for non-sliding stance on level ground. After mixer update call solveHydraulics for exact piston endpoints. Clip playback rate scales root speed equally.

colliders.feet: SOCKET_FOOT_{FL,ML,RL,FR,MR,RR}; three SOCKET_CLAW contacts per foot
colliders.note: Broad hull proxy only. Game supplies articulated limb and terrain collision.
